entities.name: Daniel Giraud Elliot
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Daniel Giraud Elliot was a wealthy American zoologist and the founder of the American Ornithologist Union. He made expeditions to Africa and Alaska and was the first curator of zoology at the Field Museum in Chicago.
